injuries.name: Filip Gustavsson
injuries.note: Gustavsson has been sidelined since the start of the campaign due to the hip procedure he underwent in the offseason. His inclusion for the team's upcoming road trip is a sign that he hasn't had any major setbacks since being ruled out for at least another month in mid-October. His status will be monitored closely, and once he's able to return, he'll likely see somewhat frequent appearances in net, but he'll be behind Jesper Wallstedt on the depth chart.

injuries.name: Jared Spurgeon
injuries.note: Spurgeon has missed seven of the Wild's last 11 games due to injury, and will likely be out of action for at least two more due to his lower-body problem. During those four appearances, the veteran blueliner failed to register a point while producing six shots, five blocks and three hits.

injuries.name: Brock Faber
injuries.note: Faber's return to practice, after having been limited to solo skates previously, doesn't guarantee he will be in the lineup to face San Jose on Friday, but it's certainly a step in the right direction for the blueliner. Whenever the 24-year-old Minnesota native is given the all-clear, he should be back on the Wild's top pairing in addition to linking up with the No. 1 power-play unit.

injuries.name: Brock Faber
injuries.note: Skull: The Minnesota Wild said on Thursday (Nov. 5) that Faber has returned to team practice.

injuries.name: Filip Gustavsson
injuries.note: Hip: The Minnesota Wild said on Thursday (Nov. 5) that Gustavsson will travel during the team's upcoming three-game road trip, per Joe Smith of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Michael McCarron
injuries.note: Undisclosed: McCarron is Out for Saturday's (Nov. 7) game versus the Lightning.

injuries.name: Jared Spurgeon
injuries.note: Lower Body: The Minnesota Wild said on Thursday (Nov. 5) that Spurgeon will travel during the team's upcoming three-game road trip, per Joe Smith of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Yanni Gourde
injuries.note: Hip: The Tampa Bay Lightning said on Wednesday (Nov. 4) that Gourde might be available at some point during the upcoming four-game road trip, per Benjamin Pierce of the Lightning's official site.
